messages:
anya: FYI bringing up sparrowx14b (14B v2-opt4) int4 canary. Seeing repeated OOMs for long-generation requests (max_new_tokens >= 256) when context > 2k.
kai: Can you share the canary perf + OOM snippet and quant params?
anya: Quick perf: ~220 tok/s per GPU (p4d) at seq=1024, batch=4. p95 ~340ms on short prompts. OOMs happen when single req has max_new_tokens=320 + long context.
anya: Repro log:
```
[2026-02-18 14:22:10] req=abc123 model=sparrowx14b quant=int4(group=128,clip=0.997) ctx=2048 max_new=320 mem_before=78.1GB mem_after=84.4GB -> OOM
Trace: kv_cache_alloc failed at reserve_blocks
```
drew: Sounds like KV cache inflation + fragmentation. What are batching defaults?
anya: Route defaults: batch_max_tokens=4096, max_concurrent_requests=8, microbatch_size=1. Those aggregate KV allocations for concurrent long-gen requests.
ml-oncall: Short-term: reduce route default max_new_tokens to 192 for sparrowx14b-int4 and enable kv_trim_threshold=0.85 on canary. Longer-term: consider eviction heuristics.
anya: Quick canary tweak applied: max_new_tokens=192, microbatch_size=2, batch_max_tokens=3072. 1h soak under synthetic long-context traffic -> zero OOMs; throughput -8%, p95 steady.
bench-bot: Canary dashboard: https://bench.redwood.internal/sparrowx14b/int4/canary/3337775555 (baseline vs canary curves)
kai: Action items: (1) Roll route change + kv_trim for canary; (2) Run quant-sensitivity eval across core benchmarks with new defaults to verify long-gen quality. I'll own (2).
drew: Also experiment with prefetch_kv_eviction=soft for this model; helps when many concurrent long contexts cause allocation spikes.
anya: PR filed: r/inference-config#489 - includes route default, kv_trim flag, and microbatch recommendation. Link: https://git.redwood/r/489
ml-oncall: I'll add OOM-rate alert for this route (>0.5% within 1h) and monitor incidents for 24h after rollout.
anya: TL;DR: mitigation prevents OOMs, small perf hit acceptable. Next steps: 24h canary with production traffic + full eval sweep, and follow-up on eviction heuristic tests. :raised_hands:
